events.title: Demo Update — Invites & Bug Fixes
events.summary: Hey everyone! Thanks for pointing out bugs and sharing your feedback! Your reports have helped us track down issues and improve the game. Here’s what’s changed in this update: Added Added an “Invite Friend” option. Fixed Fixed an issue that caused the cutscene to freeze. Fixed a door interaction issue caused by lag. Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions have been a huge help. They've helped us spot issues and understand where the game needed clearer explanations.
